name: ImageTile
description: One image in its reserved aspect-ratio box: it never moves anything when it loads.
signature: ({ image, onOpen, cover, className }: { image: ResultImage; onOpen?: () => void; cover?: boolean; className?: string; }): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: cover
props.description: Crop to a 16:10 box from the top instead of fitting the image at its own ratio. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: image
props.description: The image: `src` and `alt`, `width` and `height` in pixels for the reserved ratio, and an optional `caption`.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Called when the image is pressed; supplying it makes the image a button named "Open {alt}".
